name: PM-KISAN (demo reference)
summary: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to scheme rules and exclusions.
nextAction: Check current PM-KISAN status and land record requirements with the agriculture office or an assisted service centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance support for notified crops and areas during an applicable season.
nextAction: Ask the local agriculture office or bank whether your crop and area are notified for the current season.

name: School and post-school scholarships
summary: A range of central and state scholarship routes may support eligible students; conditions vary by programme.
nextAction: Ask the school about active scholarship applications and deadlines, then verify the student-specific criteria.

name: Public health coverage and state health support
summary: Public health coverage options may be available depending on household listing, state rules and the treatment needed.
nextAction: Check household coverage with a participating hospital help desk or the state health helpline before treatment.
